### A More Affordable
and Livable Fremont
Fremont should always be a great place to live, work, play, and learn. I will support housing options, reduce traffic, strengthen and uplift local businesses, invest in neighborhood amenities, and help ensure families can afford to put down roots, build a life, and truly thrive in our community.
### A Cleaner
And Greener Fremont
Fremont should feel like a city built inside a park, with clean neighborhoods, tree-lined streets, thriving parks, and inviting public spaces. I will prioritize maintaining our parks, repairing roads and sidewalks, supporting community gardens, and enhancing Lake Elizabeth for everyone.
### A Well-Run
and Safer Fremont
Fremont deserves a city government that serves residents with transparency, efficiency, and accountability. I will promote fiscal responsibility, modernize city services, strengthen emergency preparedness, and maintain public safety to keep Fremont a well-managed city for everyone.
## What Makes Aziz Different?
The Neighbor
My parents chose Fremont because it was affordable, safe, and had great schools. That promise is what brought our family here and what has kept me here for 26 years. Everything I am fighting for in this campaign is about making sure Fremont keeps that promise for the next family that arrives hoping for the same thing.
The Experience
Over my 10 years on Board of Directors for the Alameda County Water District, I've delivered real results: nearly 1,800 families are enrolled in our low-income rate assistance program, we’ve secured over $30 million in grant funding for local infrastructure projects, we’ve built a more resilient system to prepare for earthquakes, and we’ve maintained a AAA bond rating. I know how to deliver real outcomes that have a big impact on our community.
The Vision
I envision a Fremont where families can afford to live, every neighborhood has parks that our kids can grow up playing in, no neighbor goes hungry, and city hall delivers real results. That city is within reach.

“I have been proud to endorse Aziz Akbari in every election since 2016, when he was first elected to the Alameda County Water District. For 10 years, Aziz has consistently delivered results. Aziz has demonstrated his commitment to putting community first, and I am honored to support him once again for Fremont City Council.”
### — Congressman Ro Khanna
